schema.meaning: The registration envelope schema, not the staff-envelope schema.

intent_id.meaning: Registration envelope kernel member; the code checks presence.

transition.meaning: Registration envelope kernel member; the code checks presence.

version.meaning: Registration envelope kernel member; the code checks presence.

timestamp.meaning: Registration envelope kernel member; the code checks presence.

routine.meaning: Registration routine. routine_id must be a nonempty string. Stages are projected through caduceus.pid2.routine.v1; their content is not otherwise validated here.

stages.meaning: Stages passed through the routine seat projection.

routine_id.meaning: Routine identifier used by the operation.

changed.meaning: Whether the registration was inserted, enabled, or changed; an unchanged legacy row may still be normalized.

readback.meaning: The routine status read back after registration.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms can also appear: pid2-invalid-json: <parser message>, pid2-schema-desync: expected caduceus.pid2.routine.v1, observed <value>, pid2-kernel-missing: <field>, pid2-lock-directory: <OS error>, pid2-lock-open: <OS error>, pid2-walk-lock: <OS error>, pid2-action-lock: <OS error>, pid2-command-wake-persist-failed: <detail>, <raw SQLite or stored-envelope parser error text>. On success the final receipt reports none.
